eventMetadata.context_description: Recent model consensus and climatological baselines position 30°C as the modal outcome for Tel Aviv’s June 10 maximum, with 29°C and 31°C close behind. Early-June averages hover near 29–30°C under typical subtropical high pressure, light northerly flow, and afternoon sea-breeze moderation that limits further warming. AccuWeather’s June 2026 guidance shows daily highs spanning 28–31°C, while multiple deterministic and ensemble runs cluster around 28–30°C for the date. No significant synoptic shift or heat-advection event is indicated in the latest forecasts, keeping the distribution tightly centered on these three values and explaining their combined 86.5% market share. Updated runs from the Israel Meteorological Service and global models will provide the next catalyst ahead of resolution.
